teaser.text: Moderna is a biotechnology company that sells vaccines built from temporary genetic instructions called messenger RNA, or mRNA. Its money comes mainly from vaccine doses and some government-paid manufacturing readiness, then goes out through production, research, distribution and the cost of preparing for uncertain demand.

earnings.title: Moderna earnings
earnings.meta_description: Moderna reports next on November 6, 2026, with guidance, autumn demand and pipeline progress in focus.
earnings.opening: Moderna's next results are expected on November 6, 2026. Watch whether the main autumn selling quarter turns approved vaccines into paid demand.
earnings.closing: The full memo also answers how Moderna's business works, who its rivals are, how its management is paid, and what risks it faces.

paragraphs.text: At $236.50 a share, Moderna’s price outcome hinges on replacing COVID sales with durable products and converting its pipeline through approval, manufacturing, reimbursement and adoption. Management guides to up to 10% revenue growth in 2026, $2,900 million of R&D expense and $4,700–$5,200 million of year-end cash and investments. The outlook assumes no mFLUSIVA or mCOMBRIAX sales and targets cash breakeven in 2028.

blocks.heading: Did Moderna keep its past promises?

paragraphs.text: The annual bonus rewarded more than sales. Moderna missed its sales target, but reduced operating expenses by approximately US$2.2 billion and achieved vaccine approvals. The board therefore set the overall performance factor at 170% of target, producing Bancel’s US$4.3 million cash bonus. That may make sense when preserving cash and advancing products are urgent, but it also means executives can be rewarded before the broader medicines business proves itself commercially.

blocks.heading: What has Moderna's revenue and profit been doing?

paragraphs.text: Gross margin improved and the operating loss narrowed, but the quarter still produced a large net loss. Lower research and selling expenses helped, while an earlier $62 million benefit had flattered the comparison. Cost control is real, but vaccine gross profit remained too small to fund the organization.

blocks.heading: What should I watch in Moderna's next results?

paragraphs.text: The next decisive evidence is whether clinical progress becomes regulatory progress and whether approved vaccines become paid demand. The November 6, 2026 results call should show how the main autumn selling quarter performed, while the November 12 Analyst Day should clarify spending and launch priorities.
